END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resolve_inbound_advisor(p_phone text)
RETURNS TABLE (
  matched             boolean,
  is_assigned         boolean,
  customer_id         uuid,
  full_name           text,
  advisor_id          uuid,
  salesforce_user_id  text,
  advisor_name        text,
  chatwoot_agent_id   integer,
  is_supervisor       boolean,
  routes_to           text
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SET search_path = renovation_dev, public
AS $$
  WITH found_customer AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.full_name, c.advisor_id
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.phone = p_phone
     LIMIT 1
  ),
  owning_advisor AS (
    SELECT a.*
      FROM advisors a
      JOIN found_customer fc ON fc.advisor_id = a.id
     WHERE a.active = true
  ),
  supervisor AS (
    SELECT a.*
      FROM advisors a
     WHERE a.is_supervisor = true
       AND a.active = true
     LIMIT 1
  ),
  chosen AS (
    SELECT * FROM owning_advisor
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM supervisor
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owning_advisor)
    LIMIT 1
  )
  SELECT
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found_customer)                       AS matched,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owning_advisor)                       AS is_assigned,
    (SELECT id FROM found_customer)                             AS customer_id,
    (SELECT full_name FROM found_customer)                      AS full_name,
    (SELECT id FROM chosen)                                     AS advisor_id,
    (SELECT salesforce_user_id FROM chosen)                     AS salesforce_user_id,
    (SELECT full_name FROM chosen)                              AS advisor_name,
    (SELECT chatwoot_agent_id FROM chosen)                      AS chatwoot_agent_id,
    (SELECT is_supervisor FROM chosen)                          AS is_supervisor,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owning_advisor) THEN 'advisor'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM supervisor)     THEN 'supervisor'
      ELSE 'unrouted'
    END                                                         AS routes_to;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION resolve_inbound_advisor(text) IS
  'Inbound routing rule: assigned customer goes to its advisor, everything else to the supervision lead.';

           lease_expires_at = NULL,
           last_error = 'LEASE_EXPIRED'
     WHERE resolution.state = 'running'
       AND resolution.lease_expires_at <= now()
    RETURNING resolution.local_message_id,
              resolution.attempt_count,
              resolution.last_http_status,
              resolution.state
  ), logged AS (
    INSERT INTO interaction_logs (event_type, correlation_id, payload, success, error_message)
    SELECT 'chatwoot_wamid_resolution_failed',
           expired.local_message_id,
           jsonb_build_object(
             'http_status', expired.last_http_status,
             'attempt_count', expired.attempt_count,
             'reason', 'LEASE_EXPIRED'
           ),
           false,
           'LEASE_EXPIRED'
      FROM expired
     WHERE expired.state = 'failed'
    RETURNING interaction_logs.id
  )
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM expired) + (SELECT count(*) FROM logged)
    INTO v_expired_count;

  SELECT resolution.id INTO v_id
    FROM chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
   WHERE resolution.state = 'queued'
     AND resolution.attempt_count < 12
     AND resolution.process_after <= now()
   ORDER BY resolution.process_after, resolution.created_at, resolution.id
   FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
   LIMIT 1;

  IF v_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  UPDATE chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
     SET state = 'running',
         attempt_count = resolution.attempt_count + 1,
         lease_token = gen_random_uuid(),
         lease_owner = p_worker_id,
         lease_expires_at = now() + interval '60 seconds'
   WHERE resolution.id = v_id
  RETURNING resolution.id,
            resolution.local_message_id,
            resolution.chatwoot_account_id,
            resolution.chatwoot_conversation_id,
            resolution.chatwoot_message_id,
            resolution.attempt_count,
            resolution.lease_token;
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION settle_chatwoot_wamid_resolution(
  p_resolution_id uuid,
  p_lease_token uuid,
  p_provider_message_id text,
  p_http_status integer,
  p_error text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  state text,
  attempt_count smallint,
  process_after timestamptz,
  retry_scheduled boolean,
  callback_event_id uuid
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = renovation_dev, public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_resolution chatwoot_wamid_resolutions%ROWTYPE;
  v_provider_resolution_id uuid;
  v_event_id uuid;
  v_payload jsonb;
  v_retryable boolean;
  v_delay integer;
BEGIN
  IF p_provider_message_id ~ '^wamid\.' THEN
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_provider_message_id, 0));
  END IF;

  SELECT resolution.* INTO v_resolution
    FROM chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
   WHERE resolution.id = p_resolution_id
     AND resolution.state = 'running'
     AND resolution.lease_token = p_lease_token
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT 'superseded'::text, 0::smallint, now(), false, NULL::uuid;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF p_provider_message_id ~ '^wamid\.' THEN
    SELECT resolution.id INTO v_provider_resolution_id
      FROM chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
     WHERE resolution.provider_message_id = p_provider_message_id
       AND resolution.id <> v_resolution.id
     FOR UPDATE;
    IF FOUND THEN
      UPDATE chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
         SET state = 'failed',
             process_after = now(),
             lease_token = NULL,
             lease_owner = NULL,
             lease_expires_at = NULL,
             last_http_status = p_http_status,
             last_error = 'CHATWOOT_WAMID_ALREADY_CLAIMED'
       WHERE resolution.id = v_resolution.id;
      INSERT INTO interaction_logs (event_type, correlation_id, payload, success, error_message)
      VALUES (
        'chatwoot_wamid_resolution_mismatch',
        v_resolution.local_message_id,
        jsonb_build_object('reason', 'CHATWOOT_WAMID_ALREADY_CLAIMED'),
        false,
        'CHATWOOT_WAMID_ALREADY_CLAIMED'
      );
      RETURN QUERY SELECT 'failed'::text, v_resolution.attempt_count, now(), false, NULL::uuid;
      RETURN;
    END IF;

    v_payload := jsonb_set(v_resolution.callback_payload, '{provider_message_id}', to_jsonb(p_provider_message_id), true);
    v_event_id := enqueue_salesforce_callback(
      'inbound_message',
      p_provider_message_id,
      p_provider_message_id,
      v_payload,
      'chatwoot_waba',
      v_resolution.source_rank
    );

    UPDATE chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
       SET state = 'resolved',
           callback_payload = v_payload,
           provider_message_id = p_provider_message_id,
           callback_event_id = v_event_id,
           process_after = now(),
           lease_token = NULL,
           lease_owner = NULL,
           lease_expires_at = NULL,
           last_http_status = p_http_status,
           last_error = NULL,
           resolved_at = now()
     WHERE resolution.id = v_resolution.id;

    UPDATE messages message
       SET metadata = message.metadata || jsonb_build_object('provider_message_id', p_provider_message_id)
     WHERE message.wa_message_id = v_resolution.local_message_id
        OR (
          message.metadata->>'source_channel' = 'chatwoot_waba'
          AND message.metadata->>'chatwoot_account_id' = v_resolution.chatwoot_account_id::text
          AND message.metadata->>'chatwoot_conversation_id' = v_resolution.chatwoot_conversation_id::text
          AND message.metadata->>'chatwoot_message_id' = v_resolution.chatwoot_message_id::text
        );

    RETURN QUERY SELECT 'resolved'::text, v_resolution.attempt_count, now(), false, v_event_id;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Preserve V23's quick retry behaviour for attempts 1..7. Once that phase
  -- exhausts, only transport failures and an exact-message 2xx that still lacks
  -- a wamid enter the long tail. Auth, scope and malformed-message failures stay
  -- terminal instead of consuming a day of probes.
  IF v_resolution.attempt_count <= 7 THEN
    v_retryable := p_http_status IS NULL
      OR p_http_status = 0
      OR p_http_status = 408
      OR p_http_status = 429
      OR p_http_status >= 500
      OR p_http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299;
  ELSE
    v_retryable := p_http_status IS NULL
      OR p_http_status = 0
      OR p_http_status = 408
      OR p_http_status = 429
      OR p_http_status >= 500
      OR (
        p_http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299
        AND p_error = 'CHATWOOT_WAMID_NOT_READY'
      );
  END IF;

  v_delay := CASE v_resolution.attempt_count
    WHEN 1 THEN 2
    WHEN 2 THEN 5
    WHEN 3 THEN 15
    WHEN 4 THEN 30
    WHEN 5 THEN 60
    WHEN 6 THEN 120
    WHEN 7 THEN 300
    WHEN 8 THEN 900
    WHEN 9 THEN 3600
    WHEN 10 THEN 21600
    WHEN 11 THEN 86400
    ELSE NULL
  END;

  IF v_retryable AND v_resolution.attempt_count < 12 THEN
    UPDATE chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
       SET state = 'queued',
           process_after = now() + make_interval(secs => v_delay),
           lease_token = NULL,
           lease_owner = NULL,
           lease_expires_at = NULL,
           last_http_status = p_http_status,
           last_error = NULLIF(left(COALESCE(p_error, 'WAMID_NOT_READY'), 200), '')
     WHERE resolution.id = v_resolution.id;
  ELSE
    UPDATE chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
       SET state = 'failed',
           process_after = now(),
           lease_token = NULL,
           lease_owner = NULL,
           lease_expires_at = NULL,
           last_http_status = p_http_status,
           last_error = NULLIF(left(COALESCE(p_error, 'WAMID_RESOLUTION_FAILED'), 200), '')
     WHERE resolution.id = v_resolution.id;

    INSERT INTO interaction_logs (event_type, correlation_id, payload, success, error_message)
    VALUES (
      'chatwoot_wamid_resolution_failed',
      v_resolution.local_message_id,
      jsonb_build_object('http_status', p_http_status, 'attempt_count', v_resolution.attempt_count),
      false,
      NULLIF(left(COALESCE(p_error, 'WAMID_RESOLUTION_FAILED'), 200), '')
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT resolution.state,
         resolution.attempt_count,
         resolution.process_after,
         resolution.state = 'queued',
         resolution.callback_event_id
    FROM chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
   WHERE resolution.id = v_resolution.id;
END;
$$;

-- Recover only the live failure class that motivated this migration. Preserve
-- attempt_count=8 so these rows receive the bounded late tail, not a fresh hot
-- loop. Other terminal outcomes remain terminal.
WITH requeued AS (
  UPDATE chatwoot_wamid_resolutions resolution
     SET state = 'queued',
         process_after = now(),
         lease_token = NULL,
         lease_owner = NULL,
         lease_expires_at = NULL
   WHERE resolution.state = 'failed'
     AND resolution.attempt_count = 8
     AND resolution.last_http_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299
     AND resolution.last_error = 'CHATWOOT_WAMID_NOT_READY'
     AND resolution.provider_message_id IS NULL
     AND resolution.callback_event_id IS NULL
     AND resolution.resolved_at IS NULL
  RETURNING resolution.local_message_id, resolution.attempt_count
)
INSERT INTO interaction_logs (event_type, correlation_id, payload, success)
SELECT 'chatwoot_wamid_resolution_requeued',
       requeued.local_message_id,
       jsonb_build_object('reason', 'LATE_WAMID_RETRY_POLICY', 'attempt_count', requeued.attempt_count),
       true
  FROM requeued;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION claim_chatwoot_wamid_resolution(text) IS
  'Claims one due exact-message resolution with fencing; V24 adds bounded late probes and audits terminal lease expiry.';
COMMENT ON FUNCTION settle_chatwoot_wamid_resolution(uuid, uuid, text, integer, text) IS
  'Settles an exact Chatwoot lookup; V24 retries late wamids up to attempt 12 while preserving V14 idempotency.';

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION claim_chatwoot_wamid_resolution(text) FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION settle_chatwoot_wamid_resolution(uuid, uuid, text, integer, text) FROM PUBLIC;
"
  }
];

return [{ json: { status: pending.length ? 'pending' : 'ok', pending_count: pending.length, applied_versions: appliedVersions, migrations: pending } }];
